title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: Adult female California sea lion (Zalophus californianus) and pup at a rookery on San Miguel Island, California, USA, a long-term monitoring site for the U.S. population. Photo by Anthony Orr, NOAA Fisheries. NMFS Permit #22678. See ‘Intraspecific variation in prey quality affects the consumption rates of top predators’ (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2656.70155) for more information.
